items.t: Joby Aviation Falls 6% as Air Taxi Selloff Deepens; Archer Aviation Drops 4%, EHang Slides 2%
items.sum: Joby is burning cash on certification, aircraft production and a defense deal while its air taxis still carry no paying passengers. Every drop in the share price makes the next stock sale cost shareholders more, and that math is starting to matter.

items.t: Archer Aviation Drops 6%, EHang Slides 7%, Joby Falls 5%: Is Cathie Wood Right to Keep Buying Air Taxi Stocks?
items.sum: Cathie Wood keeps buying Archer while its stock bleeds, and the cash clock is ticking louder than the rotors. Can her patience outlast the burn, or will dilution settle the argument first?
